score_definition: Internal craft judgment, not an objective test, professional SLP approval, owner/child acceptance, physical print proof or master-audit release-proven satisfaction. 4.9 marks a near-final visual target with no observed actionable defect in that object/category at the reviewed evidence size. scoring_scope: Principal characters, story-bearing props, visible marginal objects, scene/composite integrity, typography and visual story/pacing are listed per page. Grouped effects such as intact bubble piles are reviewed as a visual object family.

coverage_proof.evidence_rule: An observation is inherited only for an exact matching PNG hash. Each page row binds both previous and current evidence; the mechanical receipt verifies all final PDF rasters match current PNGs.

original_comparison.final_comparison: The book now has actual event-specific lower-bank compositions instead of interchangeable brushes/suds. Full-art pages carry action and setting; contour-cutout pages allow pauses, dialogue and detail. The banks stay subordinate to the main action and vary between supplies, mirror/duck play, rubbish, fountain/hug, apology toys, attic fear/couch spectators, cooperative toys and rest.
